name: Chart/Combo-Chart
description:
Combo chart: an amount as bars (Chart/Sector/Primary, 20px) and a rate as a line with dots (Chart/Sector/Secondary) on a second axis at the end. Both axes label their unit; the legend names the bar and the line.


Properties
Color: Primary (default) · Secondary — Secondary swaps Color Chart Sector/Primary and /Secondary (Secondary bars, a Primary line and dots), for a chart led by Neutral Deep with the brand as its highlight. Code: palette="secondary"
Header: Title (Body/Extra/Medium) · Show Hint — an info icon (20px, Content/Neutral/Light) that holds the chart's description in a Tooltip (code: hint) · Show Open · Show Icon (off by default: chart headers carry no icon) · Metric: Show Metric Label (Body/Small/Regular, what the figure is; code: metricLabel) over Show Value (Display/4) · Show Ranges (Segmented) · Show Open, as on Chart-Card


Rules
Draws no surface of its own: it sits in a Card's Content slot, and the Card's Theme, Surface and Color give the widget its surface by the Card rules for the page's Canvas (Default, Shadow, Border, Flat-Border, Pale or Subtle; Solid for the one widget that stands out). No gradient surface.
Marks take the Color Chart Sector styles in chartPalette order; on a Solid card, the Color Chart Sector/On-Color styles.


Code: <ComboChart> in a <ChartCard> (Zen DS)
